graph_provenance.notes: Vision tower + connector: onnx_graph_walk of the real architecture built from the real config with random init (719 ONNX nodes -> 331 ops per camera, 107.66 GMAC per 512x512 image, 64 tokens after pixel shuffle x4), run for 2 cameras as lerobot embeds each camera separately. LM prefill and action expert: config_derived from lerobot smolvlm_with_expert.py/modeling_smolvla.py: prefix = 2x64 image + 48 lang + 1 state = 177 tokens; 16 VLM layers (D=960, 15 heads, 5 KV heads, head_dim 64, MLP 2560); expert 16 layers (D=720, MLP 2048), self-attn every 2 layers else cross-attn on the cached VLM K/V re-projected by the expert each step; 10 Euler steps; chunk 50 x 32 (padded) actions. Deployment dtypes are assumptions: int8 weights and linear activations, bf16 attention and KV cache. Parameter cross-check vs safetensors header (500 tensors, total 450,046,176): derived total 450,046,176; group mismatches: none. lm_head is unused at inference. The exported ONNX stores fewer distinct initializers than parameters because the exporter deduplicates identical random-init constants (zero biases, unit norm scales); op bytes_w still counts each use.
references: Shukor et al., SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics, 2025

setup.bandwidth_mode: CALC (SCALE-Sim stall-free; stall_cycles_scalesim is 0 by construction)
setup.stall_model: stall_cycles_bw_model = max(0, dram_bytes / per_tile_bw - vx1_cycles), per_tile_bw = 28.44 B/cycle (DRAM peak / NPU clock / tiles)
setup.counts: SRAM reads/writes in words; DRAM in bytes (int8 1 B, bf16/fp32 2 B words)
setup.not_covered: elementwise, norm, softmax, pool, resize, memcopy, cpu/dsp kernels are not systolic GEMMs and stay on the L0/L1 NPU model
